title: 俗世凡尘 第23章 诀别俗世凡尘 第24章 绝境

这是一个不到两丈见方的密室，中间刻着奇形怪状的文字和一些神秘图案。南宫修打开一个暗盒子，取出两枚黑漆漆的神秘石头插入图案的凹槽处，那些文字和图案顿时亮了起来，静静地运转着。
“这是？”
“此阵是祖师爷留下来的，以备强敌偷袭，留存千年一直无用，想不到今日派上了用场。”
这个法阵是云隐子创立的，能将人瞬息转移。那两个石头则是灵石，拥有神秘的力量，法阵必须得依靠灵石提供能量才能驱动。这事只有历代掌门知道，然而南宫修则是没时间解释了，所以陆多福三人依旧是一头雾水。
三人要给南宫修敷药止血，南宫修制止了他们，他如此重伤，已是回天乏术。
“爹爹……”
南宫月俏脸挂满泪珠，却是哭着说不出话来。
陆多福虎目欲裂，问道：“师父，这些贼子是什么人？为何要杀我们？”
南宫修摆手打断了他们，和蔼地道：“多福，月儿，我有话要跟你们说！”
“师父，徒儿在，您老人家请吩咐！”陆多福泪眼朦胧。作为一个医师，他当然能看出来南宫修无药可救，现在不过是回光返照。
南宫修点点头，朝女儿和徒弟道：“多福，虽然你成为我的正式弟子才一天，且为师没有将你升为亲传弟子。但自打你进云隐门开始，我一直将你视为亲传弟子对待，甚至是亲生儿子。将你带入云隐，是为师生平一大幸事，但亦有一大憾事，就是你修炼一事，不能助你半分力……”
陆多福正色道：“师父师娘大恩，徒儿从不敢忘。只可惜徒儿绝脉之躯无福承受师父的指点，修为低微，不能为师父师娘分忧。”
南宫修摇头道：“不，你先听我说完。天生绝脉，这非你之过。我的好徒弟天资卓绝，即便是天生绝脉，依然能创出大海无量这种厉害功法，将来必然前途无量，为师心里十分欣慰。现在，我有几件事情交代你。”
陆多福诚惶诚恐：“师父但有所命，徒儿自当竭尽全力，鞠躬尽瘁。”
“很好！”南宫修深吸一口气道：“这第一件事，从今以后，你要代我和你师娘照顾月儿，保护好她。”
论修为，现在的南宫月可要比陆多福高了不少，要保护也该是南宫月保护陆多福才是。但既然是师父交代，陆多福顿然没有拒绝的道理，垂首道：“徒儿遵命。”
南宫修沉声道：“月儿她骄纵惯了，你若是为难，那也不必勉强。”
“不不，师父，我愿意。就算拼掉性命，也要护师姐周全。”陆多福跪下，诚惶诚恐地道。
“很好。”南宫修哈哈大笑，扶起了陆多福，接着将一物交到他手上。

南宫月惊道：“爹，这是……您的乾坤袋？”
陆多福急忙推辞道：“师父，这太贵重了，徒儿不能要。”
南宫修坚定地道：“拿着，别耽误时间。我还有事要嘱咐你！”
陆多福只好收下道：“请师父吩咐！”
南宫修满意地点点头，指着亮起来的法阵道：“这是云隐门祖先留下的传送阵，可以将你们传到百里之外的地方，你跟月儿出去后，要尽快逃，跑得越远越好，永远不要回来了。”
南宫月道：“我们？爹，你和娘不跟我们出去吗？”

This is a secret room less than two feet square, with strange words and some mysterious patterns carved in the middle. Nangong Xiu opened a dark box and took out two mysterious black stones and inserted them into the grooves of the pattern. The words and patterns suddenly lit up and moved quietly.
"This is it?"
"This formation was left by our ancestors to prepare for sneak attacks by powerful enemies. It has been useless for thousands of years. I didn't expect it to come in handy today."
This magic circle was created by Yun Yinzi, and it can transport people instantly. Those two stones are spiritual stones, which possess mysterious power. The magic circle must rely on the energy provided by the spiritual stones to be driven. Only the past heads knew about this matter, but Nangong Xiuze had no time to explain, so Lu Duofu and the others were still confused.
The three of them wanted to apply medicine to Nangong Xiu to stop the bleeding, but Nangong Xiu stopped them. He was so seriously injured that there was no way he could save himself.
"Daddy..."
Nangong Yue's pretty face was covered with tears, but she was crying and speechless.
Lu Duofu's eyes were splitting as he asked: "Master, who are these thieves? Why do they want to kill us?"
Nangong Xiu interrupted them with a wave of his hand, and said kindly: "Bless you, Yue'er, I have something to tell you!"
"Master, my disciple is here, please give me your instructions!" Lu Duofu's eyes were filled with tears. As a doctor, he can certainly see that Nangong Xiu is hopeless and that he is just getting better now.
Nangong Xiu nodded and said to his daughter and apprentice: "How blessed, although you have only been my official disciple for a day, and my master has not promoted you to a direct disciple. But since you entered Yunyin Sect, I have always treated you as a direct disciple, even my biological son. Bringing you into Yunyin is a great blessing in my life, but it is also a great regret that I cannot help you in your cultivation..."
Lu Duofu said sternly: "Master and Master are so kind to me, and I will never forget them. It's a pity that my disciple has a broken body and is not blessed to be able to withstand Master's guidance. His cultivation is low and he cannot share the worries of Master and Master."
Nangong Xiu shook his head and said: "No, please listen to me first. It is not your fault that he was born with no pulse. My good disciple is extremely talented. Even if he is born with no pulse, he can still create such powerful skills as Boundless Sea. He will definitely have a bright future in the future, and I am very happy as a teacher. Now, I have a few things to tell you."
Lu Duofu was frightened: "Master has a mission, and disciples should do their best and work hard."
"Very good!" Nangong Xiu took a deep breath and said, "The first thing is that from now on, you have to take care of Yue'er and protect her on behalf of me and your wife."
In terms of cultivation, Nangong Yue is now much higher than Lu Duofu. It is Nangong Yue who should protect Lu Duofu. But since it was his master who gave the instructions, Lu Duofu suddenly had no reason to refuse. He lowered his head and said, "Disciple, I obey."
Nangong Xiu said in a deep voice: "Yue'er is used to being arrogant. If you are in trouble, there is no need to force it."
"No, no, Master, I am willing. Even if I risk my life, I must protect my senior sister." Lu Duofu knelt down and said with sincerity and fear.
"Very good." Nangong Xiu laughed loudly, helped Lu Duofu up, and then handed something into his hand.
Nangong Yue was surprised: "Dad, this is... your Qiankun bag?"
Lu Duofu hurriedly declined: "Master, this is too expensive, I can't have it."
Nangong Xiu said firmly: "Take it, don't waste time. I have something else to tell you!"
Lu Duofu had no choice but to accept it and said: "Master, please give me your instructions!"
Nangong Xiu nodded with satisfaction, pointed to the illuminated magic circle and said: "This is the teleportation circle left by the ancestors of Yunyin Sect. It can teleport you to a place hundreds of miles away. After you and Yue'er go out, you must escape as soon as possible. Run as far away as possible and never come back."
Nangong Yue said: "Us? Dad, won't you and mother go out with us?"
